title: Dr Karan Singh raises alarm over Amarnath route widening, says earth moving equipment threatens fragile Himalayas

ai.summary: Former Sadr-i-Riyasat Dr Karan Singh warned against using heavy earth moving equipment to widen the Amarnath route, saying it threatens the fragile Himalayas and that pilgrims can manage with 2-lane roads.

facts.claim: Dr Singh said he was shocked to read that heavy machinery is being used to widen the route to the holy shrine
facts.quote: Dr Singh said he was shocked to read that heavy machinery is being used to widen the route to the holy shrine.

facts.claim: Dr Singh urged those concerned not to use heavy equipment on this route
facts.quote: I join my voice with those who are protesting about this, and would urge those concerned not to use heavy equipment on this route.

facts.claim: Dr Singh has been raising the disaster being caused to the Himalayas due to avoidable road widening
facts.quote: Dr Singh said for many years he has been raising the disaster being caused to the Himalayas due to avoidable road widening, particularly on the pilgrim routes in Uttarakhand.

facts.claim: Dr Singh said tourists and pilgrims can manage with 2-lane roads
facts.quote: We do not have to make every pilgrim route into a motorable road just for the convenience of tourists. Genuine pilgrims will not mind walking or riding towards this great shrine

facts.claim: Dr Singh mentioned the Kedarnath disaster as an example of damage from road widening
facts.quote: In fact several disasters have already occurred, including the one at Kedarnath some years ago

ai.background_note: Dr Karan Singh, former Sadr-i-Riyasat, has long raised concerns about road widening in the Himalayas, particularly on pilgrim routes, citing environmental damage and past disasters like Kedarnath.
